unit.title: Describing Words, More Verbs, and a Longer Story

lesson.title: Describing Words: Big, Small, and Beautiful
lesson.subject: punjabi

contentBlocks.text: ਪਿਛਲੇ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਵਾਕ ਬਣਾਏ। ਅੱਜ ਨਵੇਂ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਸਿੱਖੋ ਜੋ ਚੀਜ਼ਾਂ ਬਾਰੇ ਦੱਸਦੇ ਹਨ! (Last week you built sentences. Today: new words that describe things!)

Describing words (adjectives) change slightly for boy/man words vs. girl/woman words, just like verbs did last week: ਵੱਡਾ/ਵੱਡੀ (big), ਛੋਟਾ/ਛੋਟੀ (small), ਸੋਹਣਾ/ਸੋਹਣੀ (beautiful/nice). Two new animal words: ਕੁੱਤਾ (dog, a 'ਦਾ' word) and ਬਿੱਲੀ (cat, a 'ਦੀ' word). Practice: say 'ਵੱਡਾ ਕੁੱਤਾ' (big dog) and 'ਛੋਟੀ ਬਿੱਲੀ' (small cat) — notice how the describing word matches the noun's ending.
ਤੁਸੀਂ ਨਵੇਂ ਵਰਣਨਾਤਮਕ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਸਿੱਖੇ! (You just learned new describing words!) Tomorrow we'll build full sentences using them.

objectives: Learn 3 new gendered describing words: ਵੱਡਾ/ਵੱਡੀ, ਛੋਟਾ/ਛੋਟੀ, ਸੋਹਣਾ/ਸੋਹਣੀ
Learn 2 new animal nouns: ਕੁੱਤਾ (dog), ਬਿੱਲੀ (cat)
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review last week's four verbs and sentence patterns briefly.
2. Introduce the three describing-word pairs, noting the gender-matching pattern from last week's verbs.
3. Introduce ਕੁੱਤਾ and ਬਿੱਲੀ.
4. Practice saying 'ਵੱਡਾ ਕੁੱਤਾ' and 'ਛੋਟੀ ਬਿੱਲੀ' together.
5. Complete the worksheet.
6. Preview tomorrow's full-sentence lesson.
differentiationTips: Struggling: focus on just one pair (ਵੱਡਾ/ਵੱਡੀ) until it's solid before introducing the other two
Ready for more: ask the child to describe a real pet or toy using one of today's new words
The gender-matching pattern (dog=ਦਾ ending, cat=ਦੀ ending) directly reinforces last week's verb-gender pattern — point out the connection explicitly
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a vocabulary-acquisition activity — check that the child can correctly trace/write all 5 new words (3 describing words, 2 animal nouns) and say 'ਵੱਡਾ ਕੁੱਤਾ' and 'ਛੋਟੀ ਬਿੱਲੀ' correctly.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Continues building sentences and common vocabulary per the course's description, adding describing words as a genuinely new grammatical building block beyond last week's nouns/verbs.
